title: Request Fingerprint Manifest Input v0
description: Adapter-neutral input for producing a deterministic agentmesh-request.v0 fingerprint manifest. Exactly one request source is supplied as Markdown or normalized request JSON.

markdown.description: Request Markdown source containing YAML frontmatter. The App normalizes CRLF to LF before hashing.

request.description: Canonical request frontmatter fields as JSON, with adapter-specific materialization fields omitted.
